351804.title: The extremal $A_\alpha$ spectral radius conjecture for non-strongly connected digraphs
351804.review_depth: arXiv v1 (only version) TeX read: Definition 1.1 (G', G'', G'''), Theorems 2.5, 2.7, 2.8, 2.9, Conjecture 2.10 (line 235); journal version Oper. Matrices 18 (2024) 319-333 full PDF read: Section 3 (Lemma 3.6, Theorem 3.7, Remark 3.8); 3 web searches; Lean Pool, Omega, OpenAI/math and GitHub screens
351804.summary: Fixed-strong-component reading refuted by an exact 5-vertex certificate. G* has arcs 0->1,0->2,1->0,1->2,1->3,2->0,3->0, with out-degrees (2,3,1,1) and v1 = 1. G = G* + 0->4 lies in G_5^4; G'' = G* + 1->4. At alpha = 1/4: charpoly(4A(G)) = s(s^4-8s^3+4s^2-24s+27) is negative at 781/100, while 4A(G'') x <= (2309/296) x for x = (671,1000,296,296,1). Hence rho_{1/4}(G) > 781/400 > rho_{1/4}(G''). Mechanism: diagonal Perron sensitivity x_j y_j, not out-degree. Exhaustive m <= 4, E <= 3 sweep: 204 violating G* at E = 1, none inside the source-proved alpha range. Journal version: replaced the conjecture by Theorem 3.7 (K_n^m is the global maximiser, i.e. the global reading is proved) and Remark 3.8 (the fixed-G* question, which this example answers negatively). See CANDIDATE-351804.md and the UNCOMPILED lean/AalphaNonStrongCounterexample.lean.

351504.title: The kernel existence conjecture for colored quasi-transitive digraphs
351504.review_depth: arXiv v1 TeX read in full for definitions (H-length, (k,H)-kernel, closure; lines 80-130), Theorems for quasi-transitive and 3-quasi-transitive digraphs and the conjecture (line 356); kings paper arXiv:1206.1897 abstract + TeX (Lemma k-1-dom-comp, line 217) read; structure literature (arXiv:2006.06333) noted; web search
351504.summary: The conjecture is TRUE in full scope (k >= r+2), for every H-colouring. Proof: take S = one vertex per terminal strong component T, chosen as a reversed (r+1)-king of D[T] by Galeana-Sanchez, Hernandez-Cruz and Juarez-Camacho (Discrete Math. 2013; reversal preserves r-quasi-transitivity). A path between different strong components has length <= r-1 (geodesic lemma, also Lemma k-1-dom-comp there). Absorbing paths of length <= r+1 <= k-1 have H-length <= k-1, and distinct terminal components are mutually unreachable. This is a one-paragraph bridge from a 2013 paper by the same first author, so zero credit is expected (outputs/351504-bridge-proof.md). The exhaustive search was skipped because the proof makes it moot.

345158.title: Exact-value conjecture for Ryser's function
345158.review_depth: arXiv v2 (JCTA) TeX read: Conjectures conj:weak (line 130) and conj:strong (line 509); web search for follow-ups; OpenAI/math Ryser counterexample preprints (Sept 2026) README + paper.tex screened
345158.summary: Exact value Ryser(r,t) = floor((r-t)/2)+1 for t >= 2 (the source's own Conj. 1.6). Proved for r <= 3t-1, and the weak form for r <= 36t/7 - 5; first open case r = 3t (t = 2, r = 6). The 2026 OpenAI Ryser counterexamples are intersecting (t = 1), (q+1)-partite constructions and do not transfer (padding with common vertices gives tau = 1). Exhaustive (6,2)-graph search infeasible. Parked.

345562.title: Nonexistence of infinity-regular subrows in the Kolakoski sequence
345562.review_depth: arXiv v7 TeX read: subrow, S-integral and k-regular definitions (lines 57-138), Theorem infty
345562.summary: With sigma(n) = s_1+...+s_n, the S-integral of the subrow S_{a,b} is S_{sigma(a-1)+1, sigma(b)}. So infinity-regularity of (a,b) means sigma^h(b) and sigma^h(a-1) have the same parity for all h >= 0. Nonexistence is an infinite statement about the Kolakoski dynamics (it implies recurrence-type consequences). No finite certificate in either direction. Parked.

345642.title: Conjecture on coprime splitter sets for purely singular perfect splittings
345642.review_depth: arXiv v1 TeX read (Conjecture 5.1, Theorems 1.3-1.5); web searches: Yuan, CMR 2022 (15 <= k1+k2 <= 30); Leung-Zhang arXiv:2605.09871 (Woldar, k1 = 0) abstract
345642.summary: Coprime splitter conjecture. For k1+k2 <= 30 the published classification (m in {k1+k2+1, 2k2+1}) forces coprime splitters: |S| = 1, or for |S| = 2 a non-unit s makes sM lie in the m/d - 1 < k2 nonzero multiples of d. For k1 = 0 it follows from the 2026 Leung-Zhang proof of Woldar's conjecture. A counterexample needs k1+k2 >= 31 and a nontrivial purely singular splitting, which would also refute Zhang-Ge; out of scope. Parked.

358587.summary: Circulant nut graphs exist iff 4 | d, 2 | n, n >= d+4 (d = 4 mod 8) or n >= d+6 (8 | d), (n,d) != (16,8) (Damnjanovic and coauthors, arXiv:2212.03026).
